evidence.detail: Person.decks property lazy-loads all decks for a person in a season via deck.load_decks() on first access
p.decks is accessed only to get p.decks[0].is_in_current_run() — loads all decks just to check the most recent one
self.decks = person.decks and self.has_decks = len(person.decks) > 0 both trigger the full load; decks are also iterated for color chart
'decks': p.decks — API endpoint also uses the property to return all decks

triage.notes: Removing the property requires identifying which callers legitimately need all decks (person view, API) vs. those that need only a targeted query (admin ban check needs only the active league deck). Each caller would need its own purpose-built query.
